strategy_roster.name: Eliot Waves
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(6/85) stands in for the documented linear-weighted averages, while 14-bar ROC above 0.3 is equivalent to momentum above the 100.3 threshold. Pip stops, break-even, trailing, and pyramiding are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Volatile Action
strategy_roster.entry_long: atr(high,low,close,1) > 1.5 * atr(high,low,close,14) and close > open and close > donchian_high_prev(high,24) and ema(close,5) > ema(close,8) and ema(close,8) > ema(close,13) and open > ema(close,8) and close > ema(close,8)
strategy_roster.notes: The 24-bar high breakout and ATR(1)/ATR(14) expansion are retained; EMA(5/8/13) alignment approximates the unsupported Alligator. The volatility coefficient has no supplied value and defaults to 1.5, while ATR-based stops and targets are not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Dual MACD
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(macd(close,100,200),0) and macd(close,34,144) > macd_signal(close,34,144,9) and macd(close,34,144) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: The 100/200 MACD zero cross is confirmed by the aligned 34/144/9 fast MACD, whose bearish signal cross exits. The documented 1.0% stop and 1.5% target are retained.

strategy_roster.name: PA Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: A cross below the fast-minus-slow EMA approximates the documented positive-price-action state ending and its long action; the opposite transition exits. EMA lengths 12/26 are explicit fallbacks because the source supplies names only, and the two-color-bar history is unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Cronex Chaikin
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(ema((2 * close - high - low) * volume,3) - ema((2 * close - high - low) * volume,10),3),ema(ema((2 * close - high - low) * volume,3) - ema((2 * close - high - low) * volume,10),10))
strategy_roster.exit_long: crossbelow(ema(ema((2 * close - high - low) * volume,3) - ema((2 * close - high - low) * volume,10),3),ema(ema((2 * close - high - low) * volume,3) - ema((2 * close - high - low) * volume,10),10))
strategy_roster.notes: Price-times-money-flow and two-stage EMA smoothing approximate accumulation/distribution, Chaikin, and Cronex lines because exact tick-volume AD and Cronex filters are unavailable. The 3/10/3/10 lengths are fallbacks; point stops and the signal-bar shift are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Rj SlidingRangeRj Digit System Tm Plus
strategy_roster.notes: The custom upper and lower channel with range 5 and shift 0 is approximated by prior five-bar Donchian bands. Delayed entries, timed exits, digit rounding, and 1000/2000-point protection are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: ACB1
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,20) and close > open and roc(close,1) > 3
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-day breakout with positive 3% one-bar momentum approximates the strong daily breakout; 3% is a fallback because no threshold is documented. Session boundaries, H4 ATR trailing, sizing, and virtual protection are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: RSI EA
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crosses above the fallback oversold level 30 to enter and the opposite overbought cross at 70 exits. Price-unit stop, target, trailing, and short settings are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Alexav SpeedUp M1
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish body exceeding ATR(14) is a price-normalized proxy for the documented unusually large 100-pip candle, with a bearish body as exit. The 30/90/10/5-pip stop, target, and stepped trail cannot be translated to percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Arsi Vwap Atr
strategy_roster.notes: A volatility-widened 30-70 RSI band approximates the unsupported ATR/VWAP adaptive lines, and returning through 50 exits. The documented 2.5% stop is retained and RiskReward 2 implies a 5.0% target; exact adaptive formulas are omitted.
